chains.frame: Which word best describes Dalia’s decision to speak up at assembly?

beats.text: Dalia was shaking, but she spoke out against an unfair rule in front of the school.
beats.decisive_clue: faced fear to object to unfairness
beats.reason: The detail about faced fear to object to unfairness supports courage more strongly than audacity.

beats.text: She did it by snatching the microphone mid-speech and mocking the principal to his face.
beats.reason: The detail about brazenly interrupted and insulted principal supports audacity more strongly than courage.

chains.feedback_short: Brazenly interrupted and insulted principal makes audacity the better description.
chains.feedback_deep: Initially, faced fear to object to unfairness points toward courage. The new detail, brazenly interrupted and insulted principal, instead makes audacity the stronger choice. Audacity is startling, boundary-crossing boldness; courage is facing danger or fear despite being afraid.
chains.contrast_rule: Audacity crosses boundaries; courage faces fear.
